R01.comment: always use numbers that matches with context. not to be exact but matches with context
R01.understanding: You didn't pick Yes, No, or Not sure, but your comment says that numbers in copy should fit the context they appear in, without having to be exact. That sounds like you're not fully endorsing the rule as written, which says durations, amounts and counts are always parameters and never typed in. So I can't tell whether Runway should still treat numbers as parameters, with realistic sample values shown wherever raw placeholders like %1$d or ₹%1$d appear on screen, or whether typed-in numbers are acceptable when they fit the context. Which of those did you mean?
